text: グリーンも　ここを　ぬけてったぜ！

structure.jp: ここを　ぬけてったぜ！

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.explanation: The て-form plus いく shows the action moving away from where the speaker is. てった is the contracted spoken form of ていった. ぬけてった = 'went through and on'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, casual men's talk that pushes the statement at the listener. ぬけてったぜ = 'he went through, you know'.
